tools.description: Lists the new launches this service covers: name, district, street, number of units, stage, launch date, whether it is sold out, and whether floor plans and area details are available. It covers a selection of launches during the trial. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.
tools.name: list_launches

tools.description: Searches floor plans across the reviewed launches, a selection during the trial. Filter by bedrooms, size in square feet, postal district, launch stage, features such as a kitchen window, and a maximum budget in Singapore dollars. Plans in matches meet every constraint you supplied; plans in close miss exactly one, or could not be checked on one, as shown in each plan's fit (met, missed or unknown). The close list holds at most 20 plans, those with the fewest unknowns first; close_total says how many came close and close_truncated whether some were left out, so narrow the filters to see them. Cull both lists against what your user actually wants. Each result gives the plan, its stacks (stacks_note explains an asterisk), a link to the plan image, and a price with its kind and date. When nothing matches or comes close, the reply names which filters excluded the plans. Prices are guidance from developer price lists: indicative before launch, reset on booking day, and subject to promotions afterwards. Treat them as a starting point and confirm with the agent. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

include_sold_out.description: Include sold-out launches. Not scored as a constraint.

tools.description: Quotes the Singapore property rules that apply to a buyer, exactly as published, with the authority, source link, effective date and the date each was last checked: additional buyer's stamp duty, buyer's stamp duty, financing limits and seller's stamp duty. It quotes and does not work out any duty or rate; read the figure from the quote. Seller's stamp duty depends on the purchase date, so supply purchase_date to get the right regime. A rule that is being re-checked is named without its quote. This is general information and not advice on a particular purchase; confirm with the agent.

profile.description: The buyer's status: sc (Singapore Citizen), spr (Singapore Permanent Resident), foreigner or entity

properties_owned.description: Residential properties the buyer already owns: 0, 1 or 2 (2 means two or more)

purchase_date.description: Date the property was or will be bought, as YYYY-MM-DD. Chooses the seller's stamp duty regime.
